spine.deviation_notes: A Shaman-Bear player would MISS the distinct two-tier economy: Rage OVERFLOW (past max) FEEDING a SEPARATE Glory meter that gates Walking Calamity. The single-accumulator + threshold-proc model collapses the two meters into one, so the 'fill Rage, then watch it spill into Glory, then Glory caps and meteors erupt' rhythm reads as a plain charge-then-proc. The compressed second tier is the deviation (a WATCH-ITEM accrual for steward mint review).

skills.source_skill: Maul / Furious Slam (Bear Form heavy slams)
skills.delivery_notes: in-form Bear heavy slam attacks: Maul and Furious Slam are at-target heavy slams with ground-slam AoE ('Maul and Furious Slam to demolish anything in your path'). Physical melee slam -> ground_slam (downward quake AoE). stun ailment (physical heavy-hit interrupt, native to slams). Physical -> element-neutral (physical rule). These are the Rage-generation + AoE core.

at Glory cap, Walking Calamity passively spawns meteors around the player (verbatim). Self-origin meteor rain -> ground_targeted_circle patches around player (fire meteors -> fire + burn). This is the SECOND-tier accumulator PAYOFF (Rage->Glory->Walking Calamity); secondary auto-proc stage per 7.2, the every-3-seconds loop is the Maul/Furious Slam Rage-builder.

Section-B Rage->Glory TWO-TIER accumulator: approximated as ONE accumulator (Rage) + threshold-proc (Glory-cap -> Walking Calamity); the SECOND tier (Glory) is a WATCH-ITEM accrual (steward counts two-tier-accumulator instances; NOT numbered). Physical -> element-neutral for slams (Walking Calamity meteors carry fire+burn). eras 0.4/0.5-ancients CONFIRMED (untouched in 0.5). MOMENTUM_CASCADE routes the Rage engine; PHASE_MOMENTUM routes the form-state identity.

mints_anchored.description: two-tier-accumulator: a build-up -> payoff grammar where an accumulator FILLS on one action-tier (combo-beat / stack / rune-slot / charge) and DISCHARGES on a second (invoke / spend / release), the two tiers being distinct mechanics rather than one magnitude scalar. The genre's dominant 'accumulate-then-unleash' pattern; the run's largest accrual mass (~10 kits, strengthening every basin). Engine accumulator scales a single magnitude; this needs a two-tier fill/discharge substrate.
